summary: Tenet Healthcare filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing issuance of $2.0 billion aggregate principal amount of 6.250% senior notes due 2034 under a forty-third supplemental indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A. as trustee. Net proceeds, plus cash on hand, will finance redemption of all $1.5 billion of 5.125% senior secured first lien notes due November 2027 and partial redemption of $0.5 billion of 6.125% senior notes due October 2028. Covenants limit liens, sale-leasebacks and mergers, with broad exceptions; change-of-control redemption and pre-September 15, 2029 make-whole apply. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation.
